tagline: A leading, nimble North American agriculture and renewable fuels company
hero_kpi_rationale: The Renewables segment is a key driver with record ethanol production and clean fuel tax credits, benefiting from efficient operations and favorable biofuel policies.

kpis.name: Ethanol Production
kpis.explanation: Total volume of ethanol produced by the company's plants.
kpis.description: The company produced 789.2 million gallons in 2025, a record level but slightly down compared to 2024.
kpis.signal: Record production despite a slight year-over-year decline.

kpis.name: Gross Profit Agribusiness
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenues and cost of goods sold in the Agribusiness segment.
kpis.description: Agribusiness gross profit reached $556.9 million in 2025, up 6.5% from 2024 ($522.992M in 2024).
kpis.signal: Margin improvement driven by exports and ethanol.

kpis.name: Gross Profit Renewables
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenues and cost of goods sold in the Renewables segment.
kpis.description: Renewables gross profit was $156.7 million in 2025, down 8.3% from 2024 ($170.934M in 2024), due to higher corn and natural gas costs.

kpis.name: Grain Storage Capacity
kpis.explanation: Total grain storage capacity owned or leased by the company.
kpis.description: Total storage capacity was 271 million bushels in 2025, down 6.9% from 291 million in 2024, due to the closure of several underperforming small facilities and an incident at the Sunray, Texas terminal.
kpis.signal: Reduction due to closure of underperforming sites.

kpis.name: Clean Fuel Tax Credit
kpis.explanation: Amount of tax credits recognized for renewable fuel production under Section 45Z.
kpis.description: The company recognized $35 million in Section 45Z clean fuel tax credits in 2025, directly contributing to Renewables segment results.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €3.71 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.94 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Ethanol Shipped
kpis.explanation: Volume of ethanol shipped to customers.
kpis.description: 789.2 million gallons shipped in 2025, compared to 793.6 million in 2024.

kpis.name: DDG Shipped
kpis.explanation: Co-product of ethanol production, used as animal feed.
kpis.description: 2.13 million metric tons shipped in 2025, down 13.1% from 2.45 million in 2024.

risks.title: Volatile Market
risks.summary: Volatile market conditions can impact the company's sales and margins
risks.score_rationale: The agriculture sector is subject to price and volume fluctuations, which affect company results. The company faced challenges in 2025 due to an oversupplied market and low prices. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Commodity Dependency
risks.summary: Dependency on raw materials can impact the company's costs and margins
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on the price and availability of raw materials, particularly corn and fertilizers. Price variations directly impact results, as seen in 2025 with high corn costs. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Environmental Risks
risks.summary: Environmental risks can impact the company's reputation and financials
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict environmental regulations and may be held liable for non-compliance. Compliance costs can be significant. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.summary: Increased competition can impact the company's sales and margins
risks.score_rationale: The agriculture sector is highly competitive. The company must maintain its market share against growing competition to preserve margins. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Litigation Risks
risks.summary: Litigation risks can impact the company's financials
risks.score_rationale: The company faces various claims and ongoing litigation in the normal course of business, including environmental matters. Defense costs can be significant. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Reputation Damage
risks.summary: Reputation damage can impact the company's sales and margins
risks.score_rationale: Reputation damage can negatively affect sales and margins. Risks include environmental and social issues. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.summary: Regulatory risks can impact the company's financials and reputation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations, particularly environmental ones. Non-compliance can impact financials and reputation. (default score, to be refined)
